entries.description: The gallery's guide for agents: what it shows, which pages a visitor can read without an account, where the pop-up in Waasmunster is, and how to ask the concierge about a piece. The gallery runs no MCP server, publishes no agent card and offers no agent skill, so this guide is the one resource this domain offers agents.
